rules.title: Just cause required for eviction under Rent Ordinance
rules.quote: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction. Note that the mere expiration of a rental agreement or a change in ownership does not constitute "just cause" for eviction.
rules.summary: Landlords can only evict tenants from rental units covered by the Rent Ordinance if they have one of the listed just cause reasons, and mere expiration of a lease or change in ownership is not enough.
rules.coverage_text: rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance
rules.exemption_note: Some tenancies exempt from rent increase limitations are still subject to eviction provisions, including newly constructed rental units that first obtained a Certificate of Occupancy after June 13, 1979
